name: Casaba Melon
siboNotes: Generally well tolerated on SIBO diets due to low sugar content and lack of FODMAPs. Start with smaller portions if very sensitive.
preparationTips: Choose melons that yield slightly to pressure at the stem end
Store at room temperature until ripe, then refrigerate
Remove seeds and rind before eating
Can be enjoyed fresh or added to fruit salads
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of potassium for heart health
Low in calories and naturally fat-free
